## QL DSL reference (CodeQL, java) — auto-generated by agent.dslgen.extract
## 34/59 constructs kept (42% reduction). See dialect_codeql_java.manual.txt for the hand-authored reference.

### Query shape
```
<query>            ::= <import-block> <config-module> <select-clause>

<import-block>     ::= "import java" NL
                        "import semmle.code.java.dataflow.DataFlow" NL
                        "import semmle.code.java.dataflow.TaintTracking" NL
                        "import semmle.code.java.dataflow.FlowSources" NL
                        <extra-import>*

<extra-import>      ::= "import semmle.code.java.frameworks." <FrameworkName>
                       | "import semmle.code.java.security." <VulnQllModule>

<config-module>     ::= "module" <ConfigName> "implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {" NL
                           "predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {" <source-expr> "}" NL
                           "predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {" <sink-expr> "}" NL
                           ("predicate isBarrier(DataFlow::Node node) {" <barrier-expr> "}" NL)?
                           ("predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(DataFlow::Node n1, DataFlow::Node n2) {" <step-expr> "}" NL)?
                         "}" NL
                         "module Flow = TaintTracking::Global<" <ConfigName> ">;"

<source-expr>       ::= "source instanceof " <SourceClass>
                       | <SourceClass> "(source" ("," <extra-arg>)* ")"
                       | "sourceNode(source, " <kind-string> ")"

<sink-expr>         ::= "sink instanceof " <SinkClass>
                       | <SinkClass> "(sink" ("," <extra-arg>)* ")"
                       | "sinkNode(sink, " <kind-string> ")"

<barrier-expr>      ::= "node instanceof " <SanitizerClass>
                       | <validation-call>

<step-expr>         ::= <custom-propagator-call>

<SourceClass>       ::= "RemoteFlowSource" | "ActiveThreatModelSource" | "UserInput" | <custom-source-class>
<SinkClass>          ::= <Vuln> "Sink"                      (* e.g. CommandInjectionSink, XssSink, QueryInjectionSink *)
<SanitizerClass>     ::= <Vuln> "Sanitizer" | "SimpleTypeSanitizer" | "DefaultTaintSanitizer"

<select-clause>      ::= "from DataFlow::PathNode source, DataFlow::PathNode sink" NL
                          "where Flow::flowPath(source, sink)" NL
                          "select sink.getNode(), source, sink," <alert-message>

<alert-message>      ::= STRING_LITERAL     (* e.g. "This '...' flows from an untrusted source." *)
```

### Subset catalog

#### dataflow
- `class AdditionalStoreStep extends Unit { predicate step(Node n1, Content c, Node n2); }` — Extend to add global store/read steps through a given Content (field/array/collection element).
- `class AdditionalTaintStep extends Unit { predicate step(Node n1, Node n2); }` — Extend and override `step` to register a taint-propagation edge visible to every taint configuration.
- `predicate isSource(Node n); predicate isSink(Node n); predicate isBarrier(Node n); predicate isAdditionalFlowStep(Node n1, Node n2)` — The four predicates a DataFlow::ConfigSig/TaintTracking config module implements to wire up source, sink, sanitizer, and extra step logic.
- `class Content extends TContent; class ContentSet instanceof Content` — Describes how data is stored inside an object (FieldContent, ArrayContent, CollectionContent, MapKeyContent, MapValueContent) for custom store/read steps.
- `class ExprNode extends Node` — A data-flow node wrapping a plain expression; common concrete node type for sinks.
- `class FlowState; predicate isSource(Node n, FlowState s); predicate isSink(Node n, FlowState s)` — State-parameterized source/sink predicates, letting a config distinguish tainted-value kinds (seen across many *Query.qll files).
- `class Node extends TNode` — Fundamental data-flow graph node: an expression, parameter, implicit varargs array, or synthetic node.
- `class TaintPreservingCallable extends Callable { predicate returnsTaintFrom(int arg); predicate transfersTaint(int src, int sink); }` — Declares a method/constructor that propagates taint between its arguments/qualifier/return for all taint configs.
- `predicate localFlow(Node n1, Node n2)` — Holds if there is local (intraprocedural) value flow between two nodes; useful for quick, path-insensitive checks.
- `predicate localTaint(Node n1, Node n2)` — Holds if there is local (intraprocedural) taint propagation between two nodes.

#### filter
- `class XSanitizer extends DataFlow::Node` — Per-vulnerability sanitizer classes (XssSanitizer, CommandInjectionSanitizer, LdapInjectionSanitizer, RequestForgerySanitizer, PathInjectionSanitizer, XxeSanitizer, TrustBoundaryValidationSanitizer, ...) selected via `isBarrier`.
- `class ApiSinkNode extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink node backed by a models-as-data (MaD) API sink model; base for most query-specific sinks.
- `class CommandInjectionSink extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink for OS command injection.
- `class DefaultTaintSanitizer extends DataFlow::Node` — A node treated as a sanitizer by every default global taint-tracking configuration.
- `class QueryInjectionSink extends ApiSinkNode` — Sink for database query-language (SQL) injection.
- `class RequestForgerySink extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink for server-side request forgery (SSRF), e.g. a URL used to open a connection.
- `class SimpleTypeSanitizer extends DataFlow::Node` — Sanitizes nodes whose static type (primitive, UUID, Date, etc.) is unlikely to carry taint.
- `class TaintedPathSink extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink for path/file traversal vulnerabilities.
- `class UnsafeDeserializationSink extends ApiSinkNode, DataFlow::ExprNode` — Sink for unsafe object deserialization of untrusted data.
- `class UrlRedirectSink extends ApiSinkNode` — Sink for open-redirect vulnerabilities.
- `class XssSink extends ApiSinkNode` — Sink where data is written to an HTTP response without contextual encoding (XSS).
- `class XxeSink extends DataFlow::Node` — Sink where insecurely configured XML parsing occurs (XXE).
- `predicate isSafe()` — Recurring pattern (SnakeYaml, XStream, Kryo, FastJson, XML parser configs) marking a configuration/call as safely hardened, usable as a barrier condition.
- `predicate sinkModel(...)` — Holds if an external/CSV-based MaD sink model exists for the given package/type/member spec.
- `predicate sinkNode(Node node, string kind)` — Holds if `node` is declared as a MaD sink of the given kind (e.g. "sql", "command-injection").
- `predicate validationMethod(Method method, int arg)` — Holds if `method` validates its `arg`-th argument; useful for building custom barriers.

#### source
- `class RemoteFlowSource extends SourceNode` — Canonical source class for attacker-controlled remote input (HTTP params, headers, request body, etc.).
- `string getSourceType()` — Gets a human-readable description of a RemoteFlowSource's origin, useful in alert messages.

#### structural
- `class Method extends Callable` — Declares/identifies a library or application method; the usual anchor for custom source/sink method classes (`extends Method`).
- `class MethodCall extends Call` — Concrete call-site classes used to identify dangerous API invocations that should be treated as sinks or steps.
- `class RefType; class Annotation` — Identifies a specific framework class/interface or annotation, the usual basis for scoping custom source/sink classes to a library.
- `Expr getArgument(int i)` — Navigates from a Call to a specific or any argument expression, typically used inside a sink/source predicate.
- `Callable getEnclosingCallable()` — Finds the enclosing method/constructor of a node, used for context-sensitive filtering.
- `Expr getQualifier()` — Navigates to the receiver expression of a call or field access.
